scenario_and_boundary: Stolen staff account or forged identity response, F1.
proposed_controls: SR-01/05: OIDC validation, staff MFA, session rotation, login throttling, account revocation.
conditional_residual_target_and_owner: Medium: authenticated compromise remains possible. Identity/service owner.

scenario_and_boundary: Student submits owner_id, status or a MongoDB operator; F2/F4.
proposed_controls: SR-02/06: field allowlists, typed filters, server ownership, validators and authorisation.
conditional_residual_target_and_owner: Low after negative tests. Application owner.

scenario_and_boundary: Two staff updates overwrite assignment or resolution; F3/F4.
proposed_controls: BR-09: version checks, transactions and explicit conflict response.
conditional_residual_target_and_owner: Low; users must resolve conflicts. Application owner.

scenario_and_boundary: Staff deny viewing, changing or referring a case; F2/F3/F5.
proposed_controls: SR-08: attributed read/write audits, business history, restricted append access, protected external audit copy in production.
conditional_residual_target_and_owner: Medium: privileged infrastructure access remains a risk. Security/service owner.

scenario_and_boundary: Guessed case/message identifier or unscoped search reveals another student's information; F2/F3.
proposed_controls: SR-02: relationship checks, scoped queries, response projections, consistent denial and no-store pages.
conditional_residual_target_and_owner: Low after complete access-matrix testing. Application owner.

scenario_and_boundary: Notes leak through student timeline, email, error log or referral; F2/F5/F6/F7.
proposed_controls: SR-09: separate note retrieval, safe timeline, generic email, redacted logs, explicit referral sharing.
conditional_residual_target_and_owner: Medium: human oversharing remains possible. Service/privacy owner.

scenario_and_boundary: Large forms, repeated submissions or expensive queries exhaust resources; F2.
proposed_controls: SR-10: body limits, shared rate limits, bounded pagination, indexes, timeouts and operational alerts.
conditional_residual_target_and_owner: Medium: upstream attacks require hosting support. Operations owner.

scenario_and_boundary: Officer grants manager access or administrator self-approves a role; F7.
proposed_controls: SR-03: scoped roles, independent privileged-grant approval, no mass assignment, audit and current-membership checks.
conditional_residual_target_and_owner: Medium: collusion and infrastructure administrators remain. Access owner.

scenario_and_boundary: Cross-site request changes a case using the victim's session; browser boundary.
proposed_controls: SR-05/06: CSRF tokens, safe methods, secure cookies and origin-aware configuration.
conditional_residual_target_and_owner: Low after CSRF tests. Application owner.

scenario_and_boundary: Stored script in a request executes in a staff browser; F2/F3.
proposed_controls: SR-06: plain text, contextual escaping, no unsafe template marking, CSP and no user-controlled executable URLs.
conditional_residual_target_and_owner: Low after browser tests. Application owner.

scenario_and_boundary: Database credentials or backup exposed; outage or ransomware; F4/F7.
proposed_controls: SR-04/07/11: private networking, least-privilege identities, encryption and key separation, isolated backups and restore exercises.
conditional_residual_target_and_owner: Medium: application/infrastructure compromise remains. Operations owner.

scenario_and_boundary: Worker crashes after email send, repeats notifications, or never processes jobs; F6.
proposed_controls: ADR-06: unique job keys, leases, bounded retries, age alerts and duplicate-tolerant templates.
conditional_residual_target_and_owner: Low for generic messages; provider outage remains. Operations owner.
